### Heavenly Realms
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/heavenly-realms-one-year-devotions-for-men-february-13.html
Passage: Ephesians 1:3
Points:
- People often mistakenly reduce heaven to an amplified version of earthly pleasures.
- The spiritual blessings in the heavenly realms are an active present reality, not merely a future hope.
- Through Christ's resurrection, believers are already positioned in the heavenly realm.
- Living in relationship with the risen Christ provides everything necessary to live wisely and faithfully today.

### You Can Check This Off Your 'To-Do' List
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-april-3-2020.html
Passage: Ephesians 1:4
Points:
- God chose believers in Christ before the foundation of the world.
- Salvation is entirely God's work, meaning believers cannot boast in it or bear the burden of keeping it.
- Left to human initiative, no one would have sought or chosen God on their own.
- Knowing that God loved and selected us first provides deep comfort and assurance.
